deferrals.downstream_gate: Before completing Stage 3: Feasibility and Architecture; before detailed design
deferrals.rationale: Defer final insulation-system selection to Stage 3 feasibility assessment. A qualified HV engineer must define the isolation boundaries, working and transient voltages, insulation classification, environmental conditions, and applicable standards. Handbook spacing and hipot examples remain unvalidated. This deferral permits preliminary analysis only; detailed circuit design, PCB routing, procurement, and physical testing remain blocked until these requirements are resolved and reviewed.
deferrals.scope: Preliminary feasibility analysis only; detailed design and physical work remain gated

review.comments: Stage 3 Feasibility and Architecture Selection approved. High-Voltage Quasi-Resonant Flyback topology selected with 100V OptiMOS 5 / GaN primary switch and 3300V SiC Schottky secondary rectifier. Peak switch stress 59.7V and diode PIV 2780V confirmed within IPC-9592B derating limits.

deferrals.downstream_gate: Before Stage 5 CAD layout and Stage 6 Physical Hardware Testing
deferrals.rationale: Galvanic isolation rating (3000 V RMS, IEC 61010-1 / IEC 60664-1) confirmed in Stage 3 Feasibility Report SV1000-REP-STG3-001. Physical isolation barrier (8.0 mm creepage, 5.0 mm PCB slot) to be implemented in Stage 5 PCB layout.
deferrals.scope: Architecture selection approved; detailed PCB routing and high-voltage physical testing remain gated.
